news.title: Flamingos receive big reception in Nigeria after winning U-17 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: PAY ATTENTION: Find it fast with our new search feature at Legit.ng! Nigeria's U-17 women's football team, the Flamingos, returned home on Monday, November 9, to a rousing reception in Abuja after clinching the country's first-ever FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup title in Morocco over the weekend. Goals from Awawu Bashiru and Oluebube Umejiaku secured a 2-1 victory over Japan in Saturday's final in Rabat, writing a new chapter in Nigerian football history. Players and officials were met with celebrations on arrival in the nation's capital after the remarkable achievement.

news.title: Happening now: Flamingos arrive Nigeria after historic FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup triumph
news.lede: November 9, 2026 Austine Agbo Emmanuel Top Stories 0. Nigeria’s victorious U-17 women’s national team, the Flamingos, have arrived in the country following their historic triumph at the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco. The young champions landed at the Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Abuja, on Monday morning, November 9, 2026 bringing home the trophy after defeating Japan 2-1 in Saturday’s final in Rabat, blueprint reports. Their return marks the end of a remarkable campaign that has placed Nigeria at the summit of women’s youth football and given Africa its first title in the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup.

news.title: Australia coach Popovic open to long-term contract extension
news.lede: Soccer Football - FIFA World Cup 2026 - Round of 32 - Australia v Egypt - Dallas Stadium, Arlington, Texas, U.S. - July 3, 2026 Australia coach Tony Popovic REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach. MELBOURNE, Nov 9 - Australia coach Tony Popovic is open to signing a long-term extension to stay on with the Socceroos following the Asian Cup's postponement and rebuild the team in the leadup to the continental tournament. Popovic turned down a four-year contract extension with Football Australia (FA) that would have kept him in the job until the 2030 World Cup, instead signing a deal to the end of the original Asian Cup schedule in February. With the event postponed to 2028 last week following attacks on hosts Saudi Arabia by Yemen's Houthi-led movement, Popovic said he could see himself taking a longer-term deal pending contract negotiations with FA.

news.title: 'No withdrawals' as Poland prepares to host FIFA tournament amid Infantino backlash
news.lede: It will be the first FIFA competition since UEFA voted to support a boycott of FIFA events. Hosts Poland said on Tuesday that preparations for next month's Under-20 Women's World Cup remain on schedule, as the tournament prepares to become the first FIFA event staged amid the backlash against global football chief Gianni Infantino. It will be the first FIFA competition since UEFA's 55 member associations unanimously voted to support a boycott of FIFA events after Infantino proposed and then abandoned a plan to carve off the commercial rights to the World Cup and sell 20% of them to private investors to raise about $4.2 billion. That triggered a massive football governance dispute.

news.title: Victorious Flamingos Become First African Team to Win FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup
news.lede: Goals from Awawu Bashiru and Oluebube Umejiaku secured the victory, capping a dominant campaign that included a perfect run at the WAFU-B U-17 Girls Cup. Head coach Hakeem Busari praised the team's resilience and expressed optimism about the future of African youth football. Victorious Flamingos landed in the Federal Capital Territory on Monday morning after their win at the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup on Saturday. The team won their first FIFA Under-17 Women’s World Cup title after defeating Japan 2-1 in Saturday’s final, with goals from Awawu Bashiru and Oluebube Umejiaku securing the historic victory.
